{{Top|leg}}
'''Aawala''' was a common name among [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]]. [[Historian/Legends|Historians]] noted that the name meant "sunrise," or, literally, "the last breath of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]."
